17/06/2018

Ms Alison Goody

Occupational Therapist

Northwood Community Health Centre

Northwood

Dear Ms Goody,

Re: Ms Betty Weston

DOB: 12/ 2/ 1964

I am writing to request a wrist splint and ergonomics assessment for Ms Weston, who is

being discharged today from our hospital after the diagnosis of a carpal tunnel syndrome.

Regarding Ms Weston ’s medical history and social background, she has diabetes mellitus

type two, hypothyroidism and obesity. She works as a supermarket manager for which she

Commented [May1]: No article required for names of
medical conditions as they are inherently definite, and do not
need to be distinguished. It should be ‘diagnosis of carpal
tunnel syndrome’ without ‘a’.

Commented [May2]: This clause introduces the entire
paragraph. Since the information in this paragraph is not
confined only to medical history, I added ‘social background’
to make it more inclusive.

stands on her feet all day for long hours. Although she is aware that obesity is an

aggravating factor for her tiredness, her diet is high in fat and calories. Please note, she has

a sedentary lifestyle activity.

Initially, Ms Weston presented complaining of numbness and tingling sensation in the

thumb, the index and the middle finger of her right hand over the last past three weeks. Her

sleep was disturbed by pain, but her pain was relieved by moving her fingers. She had

difficulty in unscrewing jar tops, and gripping a cup and as objects were slipping from her

fingers. She had no trauma to the right hand or pain in the other joints. On examination, her

right hand grip strength was decreased, and it had no swelling. Phalen’s manoeuvre and

Tinel’s sign were both positive, and her BMI was 32 kg/m2.

Commented [May3]: Using ‘and’ or ‘but’ to link 2 clauses
(no comma before the conjunction). Read more here:
https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=534

Commented [May4]: Parallel structure:

She had difficulty in unscrewing jar tops (parallel)
She had difficulty in gripping a cup (parallel)
She had difficulty in objects were slipping from her fingers
(not parallel)

Read about parallel structures here:
https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=535

Commented [May5]: Using ‘and’ or ‘but’ to link 2 clauses
(no comma before the conjunction). Read more here:
https://oetonline.net.au/mod/page/view.php?id=534

Commented [May6]: Comma not necessary.
